name: @decryp7/paddock-e2e
description: Playwright helpers and page objects for the Paddock app shell: test with the Chrome for Testing guard, e2e port, axe in both themes, page objects, layout scenarios, a fake Tauri IPC, settled screenshots and the retried-test reporter.
